menu.name: Artisan Pumpkin Bisque with Crispy Sage & Charred Ghost Garnish
menu.description: Hand-crafted roasted pumpkin bisque infused with nutmeg and thyme, finished with crème fraîche swirl and delicate ghost-shaped crouton cutouts. Served in premium ceramic demitasse cups with artisan sage oil drizzle.
menu.prepMethod: Prepared fresh or purchased from premium local caterer
menu.themeAlignment: Traditional pumpkin imagery with sophisticated plating

menu.name: Smoked Gouda & Caramelized Onion Witch Hat Tartlets
menu.description: Hand-formed phyllo tartlets shaped like witch hats, filled with aged smoked Gouda, slow-caramelized pearl onions, and fresh thyme. Topped with crispy sage leaf and edible gold dust for premium presentation.
menu.prepMethod: Artisan preparation or premium catering service
menu.themeAlignment: Witch hat silhouette with elegant flavor profile

menu.name: Charcoal-Activated Squid Ink Pasta with Ghost-Shaped Mozzarella
menu.description: Premium artisanal squid ink fettuccine tossed with garlic-infused olive oil, finished with hand-molded ghost-shaped burrata pearls, microgreens, and aged balsamic reduction.
menu.themeAlignment: Dark spooky aesthetic with sophisticated Italian execution

menu.name: Bone Marrow Roasted Root Vegetable Skewers with Herb Oil
menu.description: Artisan-sourced bone marrow with roasted heirloom carrots, parsnips, and beets arranged on premium bamboo skewers. Finished with house-made herb oil and fleur de sel. Presented on dark slate platters.
menu.themeAlignment: Spooky bone motif with elegant rustic presentation

menu.name: Dark Chocolate & Pomegranate Haunted Mousse Cups with Edible Insects
menu.description: Premium 72% dark chocolate mousse layered with pomegranate reduction, served in hand-crafted dark ceramic cups. Garnished with edible gold, pomegranate arils, and artisan-quality edible insects for theatrical effect.
menu.prepMethod: Artisan pastry preparation or premium dessert catering
menu.themeAlignment: Dark, mysterious aesthetic with premium presentation

menu.name: Spiced Apple Cider Reduction with Cinnamon Stick Wand Stirrers
menu.description: Artisan-crafted mulled apple cider infused with star anise, cloves, and cardamom. Served in premium glassware with hand-tied cinnamon stick wands and dried apple slice garnishes for witchy atmosphere.
menu.prepMethod: Fresh preparation or premium beverage service
menu.themeAlignment: Witch's potion aesthetic with warm spiced flavors
